ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to validate Servicing Branch
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Opportunity', NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Servicing_Branch__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Servicing_Branch__c)), OR( NOT(ISNUMBER(Servicing_Branch__c)), LEN(Servicing_Branch__c) < 4 ) )
